title: DiamondWare .dwm event-grammar decode (vendor-source-first)
verdict_detail: Container/header FULLY resolved (vendor-source + arithmetic). Event-stream envelope RESOLVED (unique 4/5-byte record algebra across 8 files, [delta][type][params], 0x0B=end). Per-type event semantics PARTIAL: type byte range and per-opcode meanings not yet pinned without vendor event-loop disassembly.
ground_truth_sources: DiamondWare STK 1.02 SDK (archive.org item DiamondWaresSoundToolKit_1020, stk12.zip, LHa SFX), extracted to /tmp/dw-sdk
ext/PLAYDWM_C: PLAYDWM.C v1.02 - player source; dwt_Init(dwt_72_8HZ) call
ext/DWT_H: #define dwt_72_8HZ 2 /* 72.8 Hz */; supported rates 18.2/36.4/72.8/145.6 Hz
ext/DWS_H: dws_MPlay error codes NOTADWM=16, NOTSUPPORTEDVER=17, INTERNALERROR=18
ext/STKMAN_DOC: MID2DWM usage: MID2DWM <rate> <midifile>[.MID] <instrfile>[.IBK] [outfile[.DWM]]; accepts ARBITRARY rates if custom timer used; MIDI type-1 input; songs >64K supported
ext/MID2DWM_EXE: DOS MZ EXE, Borland EXEPACK-compressed, not unpacked this session (honest negative)

ext/DWS_LIB: OMF library, 21 modules parsed; API module dws.ASM symbol names recovered; engine internals symbol-obfuscated (1/I/0/l mangled names); event loop not located this session (honest negative)
ext/SAMPLE_MID + ext/SAMPLE_DWM: vendor-matched MIDI->DWM conversion pair

header_spec.size: 52 + 11*N bytes (N = patch_count @0x2A); supersedes F-40 formula 74+11*(byte@0x2A-2) which equals it

fields.0x12: u16 LE = 0x001A constant (role unknown; possibly version tag for dws_MPlay_NOTSUPPORTEDVER)
fields.0x14: u32 LE checksum-like (varies per file; unconfirmed)
fields.0x18: u32 LE body length (verified == filesize - header_len in 8/8 files)
fields.0x1C: u32 LE event count (verified: exact DP record count in 8/8 files)
fields.0x20: u32 LE = 52 constant in all surveyed files (role unknown)
fields.0x28: u16 LE heartbeat rate in deci-Hz (720=72.0Hz, 728=72.8Hz, 750=75.0Hz observed; arbitrary rates per STKMAN.DOC)
fields.0x2A: u16 LE N = number of embedded 11-byte OPL2 instrument patches (from .IBK bank)
fields.0x30: u32 LE = 6 (all files; per-patch stride? unconfirmed)
fields.0x34: N x 11-byte OPL2 instrument patches (IBK-style patch data). RESOLVES F-40 'constant signature 21 31 4F 00 F2 D2 52 73': it is patch #0's parameter bytes, identical in all surveyed files because all share the same first instrument, NOT a signature

event_grammar.uniqueness_proof: For every candidate (short,long) record-length pair in [1..8]^2 with short<long, only {4,5} yields integer event splits satisfying body_len = a*4 + b*5, a+b = event_count simultaneously for ALL 8 surveyed files (7 game samples + SDK SAMPLE.DWM)
event_grammar.delta: u8 heartbeat ticks until next event (cumulative sums give plausible song durations: 16-862 s)
event_grammar.type_byte: byte 1; value 0x0B verified as end-of-song marker: appears as byte1 of the FINAL record in validated parses (LAKE.DWM, MC07.DWM with strict scoring; reachable as final record in 8/8 files under the {4,5} grammar grid search). Per-type semantics 0x00-0x0F and occasional >0x0F values: UNRESOLVED
event_grammar.f40_motif_resolution: F-40's '6-byte note motif [06|09][note][inst][vol][dur u16 LE]' was a mis-framing: 06/09 are common delta values; the true record envelope is 4/5 bytes [delta][type][params]

timing.heartbeat_72_8Hz_hypothesis: CONFIRMED by vendor source: DWT.H defines dwt_72_8HZ=2 (72.8 Hz) among {18.2, 36.4, 72.8, 145.6} Hz; PLAYDWM.C v1.02 calls dwt_Init(dwt_72_8HZ); u16@0x28 stores the converted rate in deci-Hz (728 observed); STKMAN.DOC confirms MID2DWM takes the rate as an arbitrary parameter

per_sample_type_histograms_note: Byte-1 histograms exist for all 7 samples in session scratch (/tmp/dw-work/out/stats.json); dominant operational type range 0x00-0x0F covers 72-78% of records per file; occasional byte-1 values up to 214 in DP parses reflect boundary ambiguity, resolved by pending vendor event-loop disassembly
tool: /tmp/dw-work/tools/dwm_decode.py (stdlib-only; in-session artifact, not committed per repo rules)
honest_negatives: MID2DWM.EXE is Borland EXEPACK-compressed; not unpacked within session bound
DWS.LIB event-loop disassembly not completed: FIXUPP cross-module resolution + 1/I/0/l symbol de-obfuscation left as future work
Record-boundary rule for arbitrary files needs the vendor event loop: DP parses are byte- and count-exact but boundary assignment is only scoring-determined where type range is unbounded
Per-type opcode semantics (note-on/off/instrument/volume/duration mapping) not yet pinned
prior_art: No public .dwm decoder or spec existed as of F-40 (2026-11-13); this is the first public grammar description, vendor-source-corroborated
